manual_review.reason: The complete field describes the root authorizing an archive after writers became quiet. It contains no password, API token, login header or secret. The scanner conservatively withheld automatic classification because the long slash-separated report-tree names look like a token-shaped substring.

limits: Bounded pattern scan does not prove all secret formats absent.
Binary/non-UTF8 exclusions are not secret-scanned; ZIP integrity is distinct from content scanning.
Only explicitly supplied current bytes are covered; no Git index, recursive dependency or whole-repository claim.
Public source URLs without credential syntax do not trigger a credential finding.
scope_exclusions: This review and the scan output are generated after the scan. Their metadata is reviewed directly; no recursive self-scanning claim.
The subsequent Git byte-validation receipt contains only file paths, hashes, sizes and check metadata; its own byte match is checked after staging.
Binary and unknown-format exclusions remain listed in the original scanner receipt; no claim that all secret formats are absent.
